name: Symbio™ 800 RTAC (CH530)
summary: 공개 통합 포인트 리스트에서 자동 추출했다. BACnet 85점

points.name: Active Cool/Heat Setpoint Temperature
points.note: Active chiller water or hot water setpoint.

points.name: Actual Running Capacity
points.note: Level of capacity that the chiller is currently running at.

points.name: Evaporator Entering Water Temp
points.note: Temperature of the water entering the evaporator.

points.name: Evaporator Leaving Water Temp
points.note: Temperature of the water leaving the evaporator.

points.name: High Side Oil Pressure- Compressor 1A
points.note: Pressure of the oil at the high side of compressor 1A.

points.name: High Side Oil Pressure- Compressor 1B
points.note: Pressure of the oil at the high side of compressor 1B.

points.name: High Side Oil Pressure- Compressor 2A
points.note: Pressure of the oil at the high side of compressor 2A.

points.name: High Side Oil Pressure- Compressor 2B
points.note: Pressure of the oil at the high side of compressor 2B.

points.name: Oil Temp- Compressor 1A
points.note: Temperature of the oil in compressor 1A.

points.name: Oil Temp- Compressor 2A
points.note: Temperature of the oil in compressor 2A.

points.name: Oil Temp- Compressor 2B
points.note: Temperature of the oil in compressor 2B.

points.name: Chilled Water Setpoint
points.note: Desired leaving water temperature if chiller is in cooling mode. · 범위 0°F to 75°F (-17.8°C to 23.8°C)

points.name: Current Limit Setpoint
points.note: Sets the maximum capacity that the chiller can use. · 범위 0% to 120%

points.name: Run Enabled
points.note: Indicates if the chiller is available to run or is currently running. · Inactive = Stop Active = Auto

points.name: Local Setpoint Control
points.note: Indicates if the chiller is being controlled by local setpoints instead of BAS setpoints. · Inactive =Remote Control Active = Local Control

points.name: Capacity Limited
points.note: Indicates if conditions may exist that prevent the chiller from reaching setpoint. · Inactive = Not Limited Active = Limited

points.name: Chiller Running State
points.note: Indicates if the chiller is running or stopped. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Maximum Capacity
points.note: Indicates if all available chiller capacity is being used. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Compressor 1A Running
points.note: Indicates if compressor 1A is running. · Inactive = Off Active = Running

points.name: Compressor 1B Running
points.note: Indicates if compressor 1B is running. · Inactive = Off Active = Running

points.name: Compressor 2A Running
points.note: Indicates if compressor 2A is running. · Inactive = Off Active = Running

points.name: Compressor 2B Running
points.note: Indicates if compressor 2B is running. · Inactive = Off Active = Running

points.name: Evaporator Water Pump Request
points.note: Indicates a request from the chiller to turn on the evaporator water pump. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Evaporator Water Flow Status
points.note: Indicates if water is flowing through the evaporator. · Inactive = No Flow Active = Flow

points.name: Alarm Present
points.note: Indicates if an alarm is active. · Inactive = No Alarm Active = Alarm

points.name: Shutdown Alarm Present
points.note: Indicates if a shutdown alarm is active. · Inactive = No Alarm Active = None

points.name: Last Diagnostic
points.note: Indicates last diagnostic for the chiller. · Inactive = Off Active = On

points.name: Chiller Auto Stop Command
points.note: Allows the chiller to run if conditions for running are met. · True

points.name: Remote Diagnostic Reset Command
points.note: Resets remotely diagnostics that can be reset. · False

points.name: Running Mode
points.note: Indicates the primary running mode of the chiller. · 1 = Chiller Off 2 = Chiller in Start Mode 3 = Chiller in Run Mode 4 = Chiller in Pre-shutdown Mode 5 = Chiller in Service Mode

points.name: Operating Mode
points.note: Indicates the primary operating mode of the chiller. · 1 = HVAC Cool _ 2 = HVAC Heat _ 3 = HVAC Ice (a) _ 4 = Not Used

points.name: MP Communication Status
points.note: Do Not Use This Point · Do Not Use This Point

points.name: Model Information
points.note: Indicates the model type of the chiller. · 1 = RTA 2 = CVH 3 = CVG 4 = CVR 5 = CDH 6 = RTH 7 = CGW 8 = CGA 9 = CCA 10 = RTW 11 = RTX 12 = RTU 13 = CCU 14 = CXA 15 = CGC 16 = RAU

points.name: Cooling Type
points.note: Cooling type of the condenser. · 1 = Water Cooled 2 = Air Cooled

points.name: Manufacturing Location
points.note: Location where chiller was manufactured. · 1 = Field Applied 2 = La Crosse 3 = Pueblo 4 = Charmes 5 = Rushville 6 = Macon 7 = Waco 8 = Lexington 9 = Forsyth 10 = Clarksville 11 = Ft. Smith 12 = Penang 13 = Colchester 14 = Curitiba 15 = Tai
